purpose: Bounded accept/reject checklist for first GBA/GBC seed-verification tranche. Prevents broad donor archaeology.

promote_if: Exact donor path/function/table is verified at pinned revision.
The finding supplies a capability/detail/technique/component not already superseded by Platinum or the DS donor pool.
The intended Platinum host or reuse mode can be named.
Evidence is sufficient to classify without broad manual asset review.
reject_or_reference_if: Platinum already provides the same behavior more strongly and donor adds no distinctive component/technique.
The seed depends on wholesale engine transplantation rather than a transferable technique/component.
Evidence cannot be tied to exact source/resources after targeted inspection.
The same value is already represented by a stronger donor and this source adds no distinct variant.
needs_evidence_if: Source confirms the family exists but the exact visual output or member set cannot yet be characterized cheaply.
A small deterministic render/decoder would resolve the classification.

capture: exact state sequence for one outdoor field move
one travel action such as Fly/Surf/Waterfall
seeds.accept_if: At least one choreography pattern is distinct from Platinum's current field presentation and can be re-expressed through Platinum field tasks without donor code/assets.
seeds.reject_if: All reviewed sequences reduce to behaviors Platinum already stages equivalently.

seeds.accept_if: At least one compact primitive or short sequence provides a reusable visual motif not already better covered by Platinum/DS donors.
seeds.reject_if: Families are generic duplicates with no distinct visual or choreography value.

seeds.accept_if: Timed palette sequencing is sufficiently distinct/useful as a transferable environmental technique.
seeds.reject_if: It adds no useful behavior beyond already-planned Platinum palette systems.

seeds.accept_if: The feature remains a clear novel capability for Platinum with Sinnoh-authored art.
seeds.reject_if: A Platinum/DS-native equivalent already provides the same arrival presentation.

seeds.accept_if: The combined visual-state-machine pattern has reusable value for Sinnoh puzzles/legendary objects.
seeds.reject_if: It is too Deoxys-specific to generalize beyond ordinary scripted object movement.

seeds.accept_if: Overlay/cycling behavior provides useful temporary battler feedback that Platinum lacks.
seeds.reject_if: The mechanic would only duplicate Platinum healthbox status with no presentation gain.

seeds.accept_if: At least one primitive is visually distinctive enough to redraw/re-author as a Platinum particle/component.
seeds.reject_if: All candidates are superseded by existing Platinum/DS particles.

seeds.accept_if: A specific choreography pattern remains useful despite Platinum's stronger engine.
seeds.reject_if: Only generic capabilities already used in Platinum are found.

inspect: Ruby/Emerald matching field-effect, field-move, battle-animation and weather source families
seeds.accept_if: A Ruby-only behavior or asset family materially differs from Emerald and has donor value.
A genuinely distinctive Pikachu presentation component survives a high-threshold comparison with later games.
seeds.reject_if: Material is nostalgia-only or superseded by later donor art/behavior.

first_stop: After Emerald + FireRed + PMD Red seeds are resolved, write a compact checkpoint before Crystal/Ruby/Yellow.
